text: The IC's Playbook: Turning the Tables in the Dark Money Game

runs: The VC playbook is designed to make you a disposable asset. Your playbook is about making yourself an indispensable, untouchable force. Here's how you fight back, starting today.

text: 1. Against the AI Feeding Frenzy: Weaponize AI for Your Own Leverage.

items: Pour billions into AI to eventually replace you.
Become so proficient with AI that you become the architect of the new system, not its victim.

Don't wait for training. Identify one high-value, repetitive task in your workflow (e.g., code review, generating marketing copy, analyzing customer support tickets) and master an AI tool that automates it. Document the time saved and present it as a win.
Start referring to yourself as an “AI-Augmented [Your Role].” This immediately reframes you from a cost to be cut to an innovator leveraging the latest technology.

Use public AI models to create sample projects that demonstrate tangible business value. This isn't for your current job; it's for your next one, demonstrating your ability to deliver more with these tools.
